{{Top|leg}}
A '''lightwick sculpture''' was among the [[Ansionian]] artware exhibited by the nomadic albeit non-traditional [[Alwari]] clan, the [[Qulun]], on the prairies of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]].

In [[22 BBY]], while on a [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|mission]] to prevent Ansion's [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|secession]] from the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] availed themselves of the "entertaining" nature of a lightwick sculpture in one of the chief trader [[Baiuntu]]'s portable, self-erecting trade rooms.<ref name="The Approaching Storm">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>
